observation_source: Visual inspection of user-provided chat image
visible: green, blue and magenta horizontal bars
UniXNU boot menu and prior loader diagnostics remain visible
Exiting boot services. A green bar across the top marks the loader handoff before the kernel branch.
SecurityLock: LockType: SOFTWARE_LOCK; Function: LockCapsuleInterface; Output: Lock Capsule Interface
interpretation: The quoted loader handoff sentence is emitted by DarwinBoot before entering XNU; its presence in an unchanged framebuffer is not evidence of XNU console output. No readable panic/ESR/ELR record is identified.
limits: Photo transcription only; local file path supplied by the user was unavailable to the tool, so no photo hash or copy is claimed.
